tha-ap478:1.1: Kusaṭṭhakadāyaka.] Kassapassa bhagavato brāhmaṇassa vusīmato / pasannacitto sumano kusaṭṭhakam adās' ahaṃ. // //
tha-ap478:2.1: Imasmiṃ yeva kappasmiṃ kasaṭṭhakam adās' ahaṃ / duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi kusaṭṭhakass' idaṃ phalaṃ.
tha-ap478:6.1: Itthaṃ sudam āyasmā Kusaṭṭhakadāyako th. i. g. a-ti.
